purpose: Candidate evidence matrix for five IQ Mindware capacities crossed with Signal, Evidence, Predictive Calibration and Commit.
mode_policy: Predictive Calibration is cross-cutting and mainly derived from Evidence and Commit; it is not a fourth gameplay component.

records.public_claim: Attention Coach Signal directly trains controlled extraction of a majority relation under visual interference and time pressure.
records.caveat: Evidence is strongest for the trained mechanism and selected cognitive-task transfer, not sustained everyday focus or workplace performance.

records.public_claim: The planned Evidence Control mode is grounded in established sequential-evidence and adaptive-learning research.
records.caveat: No direct study has validated the exact IQ Mindware task, scoring model or training benefit.

records.public_claim: Predictive Calibration will describe how expectations and confidence shape evidence use and updating across repeated sessions.
records.caveat: It is a derived profile, not a fourth game, and cannot be inferred from accuracy or confidence alone.

records.public_claim: The planned Decision Timing mode targets proportionate stopping under changing evidence and time constraints.
records.caveat: The current Signal task does not directly train freely chosen evidence sampling or real-world decision timing.

records.public_claim: WM Coach Relational Memory directly practises maintaining and comparing relations across delay and interference.
records.caveat: Relational integration is strongly associated with reasoning, but the exact app and broader transfer remain unvalidated and the WM-training literature is mixed.

records.public_claim: The planned mode extends relation maintenance into inference and updating from successive examples.
records.caveat: Comparison and adaptive-learning evidence support the rationale, not the exact task or app-specific benefit.

records.public_claim: A future profile can test whether confidence in a maintained relation tracks accuracy and lure difficulty.
records.caveat: Working-memory confidence can be load-sensitive while remaining overconfident and poorly discriminating; confidence is not a capacity score.

records.public_claim: The planned mode tests when a relation is stable enough to use without premature guessing or repeated checking.
records.caveat: Repeated-checking evidence informs the mechanism but does not establish treatment or app benefit.

records.public_claim: WM Coach Binding Memory directly practises maintaining which feature, location or context belongs with which other element.
records.caveat: The paradigm basis is strong, but exact-app reliability and broader source-memory or workflow benefits are not established.

records.public_claim: The planned mode asks users to construct and revise a feature-source-context binding from successive observations.
records.caveat: Source-monitoring research supports the construct, not the exact intervention or training effect.

records.public_claim: A future profile can estimate whether confidence tracks conjunction completeness, source reliability and context stability.
records.caveat: Binding confidence must be modelled separately for complete matches, partial matches and swaps.

records.public_claim: The planned mode tests when a source-claim or feature-context binding is adequately verified for use.
records.caveat: The task must manipulate checking cost, error cost and reversibility; reaction time alone is insufficient.

records.public_claim: Path Prediction will train discrimination among expected, rare-but-valid, context-invalid and impossible transitions.
records.caveat: The computational basis is strong, but the exact game and transfer effects remain unvalidated.

records.public_claim: The planned mode targets transition learning, context inference and revision after graph change.
records.caveat: No direct evidence yet supports the exact app or improved real-world path planning.

records.public_claim: A future profile can estimate how appropriately confidence in a path model changes with volatility and predictability.
records.caveat: Model uncertainty is not direct neural precision or a stable trait.

records.public_claim: The planned mode targets evidence-sensitive exploration and path commitment under changing information value.
records.caveat: The evidence supports the general decision problem, not the exact app or improved strategic decisions.

records.public_claim: Reasoning mode will train recovery of explicit relational structure across symbolic, nonsense-semantic and domain-semantic forms.
records.caveat: Formal-reasoning and argument-mapping evidence do not validate the exact item bank or broad critical-thinking transfer.

records.public_claim: The planned mode targets evidence evaluation, alternative-model testing and proportionate belief revision.
records.caveat: Evidence supports specific instructional methods, not a general claim that the app improves real-world judgement.

records.public_claim: Belief Calibration will test whether confidence in a conclusion is proportionate to the structure and quality of the evidence.
records.caveat: This is not a truth detector, ideology score or clinical belief assessment; confidence and discriminability must be modelled separately.

records.public_claim: The planned mode targets proportionate closure: accept, reject, defer or test according to evidence, cost and reversibility.
records.caveat: There is no direct evidence yet that the exact task reduces overthinking, indecision or premature conclusions in real workflows.

application_records.public_claim: A domain-semantic reasoning route may practise generating, comparing and testing alternative interpretations of a demanding situation.
application_records.caveat: This is not psychotherapy, treatment of anxiety or depression, or evidence that a generic reasoning game changes health outcomes.

application_records.public_claim: A partner-led protocol may study how people update interpretations of ambiguous or emotionally salient information.
application_records.caveat: Category-level evidence does not validate IQ Mindware as treatment; symptom effects are mixed and health/research governance is required.

application_records.public_claim: A pilot route may train explicit separation of validity, believability, evidence strength and confidence.
application_records.caveat: The route is evidence-informed and pilot-ready, not proven to improve consequential professional judgement.
